SELECT c.column_name, pc.transform
            FROM "__ducklake_metadata___copy_source".ducklake_table t
            JOIN "__ducklake_metadata___copy_source".ducklake_schema s
              ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id AND s.end_snapshot IS NULL
            JOIN "__ducklake_metadata___copy_source".ducklake_partition_info pi
              ON pi.table_id = t.table_id AND pi.end_snapshot IS NULL
            JOIN "__ducklake_metadata___copy_source".ducklake_partition_column pc
              ON pc.partition_id = pi.partition_id AND pc.table_id = t.table_id
            JOIN "__ducklake_metadata___copy_source".ducklake_column c
